name: mix_timeline
description: Mix a timeline's audible audio into one file, in timeline time. Every segment is seeked, optionally re-timed and gain-scaled, delayed to its timeline position, and summed onto a silent bed — so gaps stay silent and output time equals timeline time. Unlike materialize_cut, which concatenates one track's keeps, this positions and overlaps.

input.description: Mix spec: {duration, sampleRate?, segments:[{src, in, out, start, volume?, speed?}]}

output.description: Path to the mixed audio file (16 kHz mono pcm_s16le WAV by default — whisper.cpp's native input)

params.name: sample-rate
params.description: Output sample rate in Hz (default: the spec's sampleRate, else 16000)
